title: A Canadian pro forma invoice for an export to the United States, on Letter paper
person: A customer service representative at an Ottawa instrument maker preparing a pro forma for a US customer's advance payment.
review: Pro forma invoice PF-2026-0063 from Granite Shield Instruments Ltd. to Lakeshore Survey Partners LLC: two GNSS receivers (8526.91, Canada) at 9,850.00 and two survey poles (9015.90, Canada) at 420.00, total 20,540.00 CAD, no GST/HST on the export, CPT Buffalo, NY, Incoterms 2020, payment in advance to the Canadian account; Canadian English labels; US Letter; dates 2026-10-13.
revised_review: Three receivers instead of two; the total follows.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Every label in Canadian English: GST/HST, not VAT.
Each goods line has its HS code and origin, the note says no GST/HST is charged on the export, and the total is 20,540.00 CAD.
Three receivers: total 30,390.00 CAD, nothing else changed.
